Boiled Custard.paprikarecipe.directions:
Scald the milk.
Beat the eggs and sugar together.
Pour the hot milk over the eggs, stirring.
Cook over water until it coats a spoon.
Cool, then stir in the vanilla.
Boiled Custard.paprikarecipe.ingredients:
1 quart milk
4 eggs
1/2 cup sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
Boiled Custard.paprikarecipe.name: Boiled Custard
